cohort: Nulliparous women with a term, live, singleton, cephalic fetus ≥ 2500 g
finding: While allowing a longer second stage of labor (more than three hours) reduced the cesarean section rate in nulliparous women, surviving neonates had a higher risk of permanent neurologic handicap.
mod_finding: Among nulliparous women with a second stage of labor lasting more than three hours, 84% were spared a cesarean section by allowing a longer second stage, but surviving neonates had a higher risk of permanent neurologic handicap.
